create_VAELoss: create a VAELoss module with configurable mse, lpips, and kl loss scales for VAE training
get_posterior_metrics: get the KL divergence metric from a VAE posterior distribution
get_recon_metrics: get mse, lpips, and psnr reconstruction metrics comparing predicted and original pixel values
get_all_metrics: get all posterior and reconstruction metrics combined into a single dictionary
get_all_metrics_and_losses: get all metrics and scaled loss values for VAE training optimization
